resources.string: Get AI
Needs the AI add-on
AI lyrics run in an add-on called KJB AI. KJB downloads it, then your phone asks you to allow and confirm the install. The add-on has no icon of its own.
Get the AI add-on to keep using it
AI lyrics now run in an add-on called KJB AI. The AI files already on your phone move over to it, so nothing big downloads again.
Update the AI add-on
This version of KJB needs a newer AI add-on. KJB downloads it, then your phone asks you to confirm.
Update
AI add-on not recognised
The app called KJB AI on your phone isn\'t KJB\'s own. Uninstall it, then get the AI add-on again.
AI add-on not responding
KJB tries again in a moment.
Getting the add-on · %1$s of %2$s
Allow installs from KJB
Your phone asks once to let KJB install the AI add-on. Turn on Allow from this source, then come back to KJB.
Open settings
Confirm the install
Your phone asks you to confirm. KJB AI has no icon of its own: it shows in your phone\'s settings, under Apps.
Cancel
Couldn\'t get the AI add-on
This version of KJB has no AI add-on to download.
The download stopped. Trying again goes on from where it stopped.
The add-on couldn\'t be downloaded as it should be. Try again later.
The downloaded file isn\'t KJB\'s AI add-on, so KJB deleted it.
Your phone didn\'t install the add-on. Try again.
Moving the AI files
The AI files already on your phone move over to the AI add-on. Nothing is downloaded.
